text: The single criterion that matters most is ensuring the chosen bus contractor can meet project deadlines and provide reliable service at an affordable cost without compromising safety standards or quality of workmanship. Based on this principle, I recommend Option C: "the contractor able to start Monday." This approach ensures immediate availability while still adhering to the requirement of starting no later than Monday. By focusing solely on the ability to begin operations promptly, the decision process becomes more efficient and less time-consuming, ultimately saving valuable resources and minimizing potential delays in school transportation services.
